dedupe_keys.name: the catalogue of 1987 2023 earthquakes in the western french alps north of 43 5 n

description: The catalogue of 1987–2023 earthquakes in the western (French) Alps north of 43.5°N is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Mickael Langlais et al. The western Alpine belt is the focal point of moderate but constant seismic activity. Numerous geodynamic and seismological studies underline the many scientific questions linked to Alpine dynamic processes and the associated rate of deformation resulting from late continental collision phases, and the assessment of seismic hazard and its associated risks. Coverage: national (FR); published in 2024. Formats: CSV, TXT. The data are held in Data Terra and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence of the data is not stated in the sources read (the paper itself is open access). Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
